evidence.title: 中国が独自に育成したコウシンバラ3品種の苗がオンラインで販売開始
evidence.body: [e001:f01] (1 / 4 枚) 特別な思いが込められた中国が独自に育成したコウシンバラの新品種「宝華」「文秀」「嬌龍」のオンライン販売が24日に始まった。 [e001:f02] 時代の精神を象徴するこれらのコウシンバラをオンラインで手軽に購入し、自宅で育てることができるようになる。 [e001:f03] 【 その他の写真 】 「宝華」「文秀」「嬌龍」という3種類のコウシンバラにはそれぞれ感動的な名付けエピソードがある。 [e001:f04] 「宝華」は、あるネットユーザーが提案した名前だ。 [e001:f05] 2025年末、山東省のネットユーザーが叔父の名前から「宝華」という名前を応募したところ、たくさんのネットユーザーが次々と票を投じた。 [e001:f06] 応募したネットユーザーはその理由について、「叔父はまるで『花のような人』で、多くの家庭によくいる派手さはないものの、芯がある年長者、黙々と生活の土壌に根を生やし、力強く花を咲かせる普通の人を思い出させてくれる」としている。 [e001:f07] 科学研究機関は、柔軟な姿勢でそのネットユーザーの素朴な思いを受け止め、コウシンバラに叔父への思いが込められ、人情味ある物語が添えられた名前が付けられた。 [e001:f08] 「文秀」は、貧困脱却事業に身を捧げ、19年に記録的な豪雨に見舞われた百坭村に戻る途中で山津波に遭い、殉職した全国優秀共産党員・黄文秀さんの名前から付けられた。 [e001:f09] その花言葉は「熱烈、無私の愛」で、黄さんの末端に根差し、貧困脱却事業のために若い自分を捧げた偉大な精神を反映している。 [e001:f10] 「嬌龍」は、科学研究チームが2年半かけて育成した国産のコウシンバラの品種で、 新疆ウイグル自治区 の農産品ブランディングと生産・販売サービスセンターの故・賀嬌龍元主任に敬意を示すために、その名前から付けられた。 [e001:f11] 「情熱さえあれば、どんな困難や障害も乗り越えることができる」という花言葉は、賀元主任の情熱をかけて故郷をPRした姿を生き生きと反映している。 [e001:f12] 今回オンラインで販売が始まったこの3種類のコウシンバラには、奥深い思いと精神が込められているほか、品質や観賞性も非常に優れている。 [e001:f13] 3種類のコウシンバラはどれも科学研究チームが丹精込めて育成し、適応性や観賞特性が高い。 [e001:f14] 消費者に手ごろな価格で気軽に購入してもらえるよう、今回のオンライン販売は全国一律送料無料となっており、36．6元（約880円）でコウシンバラの幼苗を2株購入することができる。 [e001:f15] （提供/ 人民網日本語版 ・編集/KN） コメントを読む ※本記事はニュース提供社の記事であり、RecordChinaの立場を代表するものではありません。 [e001:f16] すべてのコンテンツの著作権は、ニュース提供社に帰属します。

evidence.title: The S&P 500 and Dow Are on Track to Beat the Nasdaq for the First Time Since 2022. Here's What That Means for Investors.
evidence.body: [e004:f01] In 2023, 2024, and 2025, the Nasdaq Composite ( ^IXIC -0.22% ) outperformed the S&P 500 ( ^GSPC +0.21% ) , and both indexes outperformed the Dow Jones Industrial Average ( ^DJI +1.03% ) . [e004:f02] And until recently, the Nasdaq was outpacing the S&P 500 and Dow yet again in 2026. [e004:f03] But a sell-off in tech stocks has pushed the Nasdaq's year-to-date total return (capital gains plus dividends) to 7.8%, underperforming the S&P 500's 9% total return and the Dow's 9.1%. [e004:f04] Here's what you need to know about what's driving the Nasdaq's underperformance, and how it could be affecting your investment portfolio . [e004:f05] Growth stock dominance is being tested The Nasdaq lost around a third of its value in 2022 because of inflationary pressures and valuation concerns amid a post-pandemic recovery. [e004:f06] Index 2022 2023 2024 2025 2026 (as of Market Close July 27) Nasdaq Composite (32.5%) 44.6% 29.6% 21.1% 7.8% S&P 500 (18.1%) 26.3% 25% 17.9% 9% Dow Jones Industrial Average (6.9%) 16.2% 15% 14.9% 9.1% Data source: YCharts. [e004:f07] The Nasdaq is far more heavily weighted in tech stocks and tech-focused companies than the S&P 500 and the Dow, so it benefited more from AI-driven stock gains. [e004:f08] Tech and tech-focused companies also have a heavier weighting in the S&P 500 than the Dow, although the Dow has become more representative of the modern market with the addition of several tech-focused companies -- most recently Alphabet ( GOOG +1.85% ) ( GOOGL +2.20% ) in June. [e004:f09] So when market leadership shifts from growth stocks to value stocks, like in 2022, the Dow tends to outperform the S&P 500 and Nasdaq. [e004:f10] Alphabet and Apple reflect current market sentiment The Dow and S&P 500 overtaking the Nasdaq's year-to-date return shows a shift in market leadership toward value-focused sectors. [e004:f11] The results were nothing short of spectacular -- record revenue, a big jump in earnings , and 34% operating margins. [e004:f12] And that increased capex caused Alphabet to report its first negative free cash flow (FCF) quarter in over a decade. [e004:f13] And Alphabet shows no signs of slowing its spending, raising its full-year capex guidance in line with Amazon 's and calling for even higher spending in 2027. [e004:f14] The sell-off in hyperscalers like Alphabet, Amazon, and Microsoft -- and the broader pullback in semiconductor stocks -- shows that some investors are growing skeptical of the return on investment of AI spending. [e004:f15] Apple is hovering around an all-time high because it is generating consistently decent growth that doesn't depend on AI spending and still stands to benefit from AI long-term. [e004:f16] After all, Apple's gains have benefited the Nasdaq more than the S&P 500 or the Dow, and yet the Nasdaq is still underperforming.

S&P Global to acquire majority stake in Agusto & Co. in Africa expansion
evidence.body: [e003:f01] Samson Akintaro Senior Analyst 3 min read Follow Us on Google Discover S&P Global has agreed to acquire a majority stake in Agusto & Co., one of Africa’s leading credit rating agencies, in a deal aimed at strengthening its presence in the continent’s domestic credit ratings market. [e003:f02] The two organisations disclosed this on Tuesday in a joint statement made available to Nairametrics. [e003:f03] The transaction, which is subject to regulatory approvals, will see the global financial intelligence and ratings company partner with Agusto & Co., whose operations span Nigeria, Kenya, Rwanda and Ghana. [e003:f04] Although the financial terms of the deal were not disclosed, both companies said the partnership is expected to accelerate the growth of credit markets across Africa by combining S&P Global’s international expertise with Agusto & Co.’s regional knowledge. [e003:f05] Also Read ETI reports pre-tax profit of N584.01 billion in H1 2026 FGN Opens $110 Million debt financing window for tech & creative startups under the iDICE programme U.S. urges Nigeria, other countries to quit ICC after Chad’s exit What they are saying According to the statement, the investment will complement the growth strategy of S&P Global Ratings in Africa by expanding market insights, improving credit transparency and supporting investors and issuers across the continent. [e003:f06] Yann Le Pallec, President of S&P Global Ratings, said the acquisition demonstrates the company’s long-term commitment to Africa’s capital markets. [e003:f07] “ We are delighted to partner with Agusto & Co. to strengthen our domestic ratings presence across Africa,” Le Pallec said. [e003:f08] He added that Africa presents significant growth opportunities, noting that combining S&P Global’s global expertise with Agusto & Co.’s local market knowledge would foster informed analysis, strengthen market dialogue and boost investor confidence both within Africa and internationally. [e003:f09] According to Adelekan, the partnership fulfils the vision of the company’s late founder to affiliate with a leading global credit rating agency. [e003:f10] He said Agusto & Co. has spent more than three decades building a trusted credit rating institution across Africa and believes the partnership will create new opportunities for market participants while supporting the development of transparent and resilient credit markets. [e003:f11] Despite the acquisition, Agusto & Co. will continue operating as a separate ratings entity, issuing its own credit ratings and methodologies in line with applicable regulatory requirements. [e003:f12] Regulatory approvals pending The transaction remains subject to customary closing conditions, including approvals from relevant regulators in the jurisdictions where Agusto & Co. operates. [e003:f13] S&P Global also stated that the acquisition is not expected to have a material impact on the financial performance of either S&P Global or S&P Global Ratings. [e003:f14] The acquisition marks one of the most significant investments by a global credit ratings provider in Africa’s domestic ratings industry. [e003:f15] In May, the global rating agency upgraded Nigeria’s long-term foreign and local currency credit ratings to ‘B’ from ‘B-’ , citing President Bola Ahmed Tinubu’s economic reforms, improved foreign exchange liquidity, stronger fiscal revenues, and rising external reserves. [e003:f16] The global agency also affirmed Nigeria’s short-term sovereign ratings at ‘B’, while raising the country’s national scale ratings to ‘ngA+/ngA-1’ from ‘ngBBB+/ngA-2’, with a stable outlook.

evidence.title: 【FRB金利発表直前】ドル堅調で金価格は1週間ぶり安値、地政学リスク後退も重し
evidence.body: [e006:f01] 米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）の最新の金利決定を控え、国際金価格は約1カ月ぶりの高値圏で推移するドルに圧迫され、現物金は一時1週間ぶりの安値を付けた。 [e006:f02] 市場はFRBが今回の連邦公開市場委員会（FOMC）で政策金利を据え置くと広く予想しているが、その後の政策経路、特に9月の利上げの可能性については依然として不確実性が高く、投資家はジェローム・パウエル議長の会見で示される政策シグナルを注視している。 [e006:f03] コメルツ銀行は、金利見通しが反転しない限り金ETFへの資金還流は見込めないとして、年末の金価格予想を1オンス＝4500ドルに下方修正した。 [e006:f04] 国際金価格は、米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）が最新の金利決定を発表するのを前に軟調に推移した。 [e006:f05] 2月末に米国とイスラエルがイランへの軍事作戦を開始して以来、金価格は約24％下落している。 [e006:f06] また、イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）と日本銀行もそれぞれ木曜日と金曜日に金融政策決定会合の結果を公表する予定で、両中銀も政策金利を据え置き、インフレリスクに警戒を続けるとの見方が大勢だ。 [e006:f07] TD証券のグローバル商品戦略責任者、バート・メレク氏は「石油市場が先週の100ドル超から90ドル（約1.5万円）へと下落したことで、金利見通しの低下につながった」と分析する。 [e006:f08] トランプ大統領が交渉の進展を示唆した後、北海ブレント原油先物は8％超急落し、1週間ぶりの安値を付けた。 [e006:f09] コメルツ銀行は火曜日、今年末の金価格予想を従来予想から300ドル引き下げ、1オンス＝4500ドル（約74万円）に修正したと発表した。 [e006:f10] 市場の焦点はFRBの決定に加え、木曜日に発表される米国の6月の個人消費支出（PCE）物価指数にも集まっている。 [e006:f11] 韓国ウォン建ての1キログラム金地金は27日、1グラム当たり19.26万ウォン（約2.2万円）で取引を終え、前日比1.47％上昇した。 [e006:f12] しかし、1月29日に付けた年初来高値の26.98万ウォン（約3万円）からは依然として3割近く下落している。 [e006:f13] ベトナムの国内金価格も同様に下落し、SJC金地金の売値は1テール当たり1億4150万ドンに値を下げた。 [e006:f14] 市場関係者は、年初来高値からの金価格の大幅な調整は、利益確定売りと高金利環境の二重の打撃が主因と分析する。 [e006:f15] 中東の地政学リスクは伝統的に金などの安全資産に有利に働くが、米国とイランの衝突が原油価格を1バレル100ドル超に押し上げたことで、インフレ再燃への懸念が強まり、市場のFRB利下げ期待が後退。 [e006:f16] FRBの決定とパウエル議長の発言が間もなく明らかになる中、貴金属市場の短期的な方向性は、政策声明におけるインフレ、雇用、そして将来の金利経路に関する文言の変化に大きく左右されることになる。

evidence.title: Update: US Equity Indexes Mixed as Chipmakers Restrain Nasdaq, Crude Oil Slides
evidence.body: [e007:f01] The Dow Jones Industrial Average jumped 1.3% to 52,877.4, with the S&P 500 up 0.4% to 7,442.7 after midday Tuesday. [e007:f02] The Nasdaq Composite was little changed at 24,933.8. [e007:f03] Energy, technology, and industrials were the sole decliners while consumer staples, healthcare, and materials topped the gainers. [e007:f04] VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH), with net assets of $77.2 billion, slumped 3%. [e007:f05] Among companies with a market capitalization of more than $200 billion, seven of the 10 worst performers were from the semiconductors and semiconductor equipment and materials industries, according to data compiled by Finviz. [e007:f06] Shares of Corning (GLW) sank 16%, the worst performer on the S&P 500, after the company reported Q2 results and set guidance for the next quarter. [e007:f07] In geopolitical news, President Donald Trump said talks with Iran were continuing but again threatened to destroy Iranian bridges and power plants if no deal is made, CNN reported. [e007:f08] Iran's foreign ministry spokesman, Esmaeil Baghaei, said Tehran was not negotiating with the US but added that "intermediaries may convey messages from the American side to us regarding ongoing developments in the region," Al Jazeera, a Middle East broadcaster, reported. [e007:f09] The front-month US West Texas Intermediate slumped 4.7% to $78.71 a barrel, and global benchmark North Sea Brent dropped 5.3% to $83.69 a barrel. [e007:f10] US Treasury yields fell, with the 10-year down 4.7 basis points to 4.59% and the two-year lower by 5.9 basis points to 4.26%. [e007:f11] In precious metal markets, gold futures fell 1% to $4,038.2, and silver futures declined 1.8% to $57.64. [e007:f12] In economic news, the Conference Board's measure of consumer confidence decreased to 90.8 in July from 92.2 in June, below the 92.4 expected in a Bloomberg-compiled survey. [e007:f13] Further in company news, IQVIA (IQV) reported a year-over-year increase in Q2 adjusted earnings and revenue, and raised its 2026 outlook. [e007:f14] Its shares surged 14%, the top gainer on the S&P 500.

evidence.title: Update: US Equity Indexes Mixed as Semiconductor Heavyweights Restrain Nasdaq
evidence.body: [e008:f01] The Dow Jones Industrial Average jumped 1.1% to 52,802.1, with the S&P 500 up 0.4% to 7,441.4 ahead of Tuesday's close. [e008:f02] The tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite was little changed at 24,929.2. [e008:f03] Energy, technology, and industrials were the sole decliners while healthcare, materials, and consumer staples topped the gainers. [e008:f04] VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH), with net assets of $77.2 billion, fell 2.7%. [e008:f05] Among companies with a market capitalization of more than $200 billion, eight of the 10 worst performers were from the semiconductors and semiconductor equipment and materials industries, according to data compiled by Finviz. [e008:f06] Shares of Corning (GLW) sank 13%, the second-worst performer on the S&P 500, after the company reported Q2 results and set guidance for the next quarter. [e008:f07] In geopolitical news, President Donald Trump said talks with Iran were continuing but again threatened to destroy Iranian bridges and power plants if no deal is made, CNN reported. [e008:f08] Iran's foreign ministry spokesman, Esmaeil Baghaei, said Tehran was not negotiating with the US but added that "intermediaries may convey messages from the American side to us regarding ongoing developments in the region," Al Jazeera, a Middle East broadcaster, reported. [e008:f09] Iran's military said any ships belonging to a country or company using frozen Iranian assets will be blocked from transiting the Strait of Hormuz, CNN cited Iranian state media. [e008:f10] Front-month US West Texas Intermediate slumped 4.2% to $79.12 a barrel, and global benchmark North Sea Brent dropped 5% to $83.94 a barrel. [e008:f11] US Treasury yields fell, with the 10-year down 4.1 basis points to 4.6% and the two-year lower by 4.8 basis points to 4.28%.

evidence.title: Scorpio Gold Announces Intention to Pursue Nasdaq Listing of American Depositary Shares
evidence.body: [e002:f01] The ratio of common shares represented by each ADS will be determined in connection with the proposed listing process, taking into account the Company's objective of establishing an appropriate U.S. trading price for the ADSs while satisfying Nasdaq's initial listing requirements. [e002:f02] The Company currently expects each ADS to represent approximately 20 common shares. [e002:f03] The ADS program is expected to be administered by a U.S. depositary bank pursuant to a deposit agreement customary for cross-border listings of this nature. [e002:f04] In connection with the establishment of the ADS program, the U.S. depositary bank is expected to file a registration statement on Form F-6 with the SEC to register the ADSs to be issued under the deposit agreement. [e002:f05] Holders of ADSs will have a beneficial interest in the Company's common shares represented by the ADSs in accordance with the terms of the applicable deposit agreement. [e002:f06] The Company's common shares would continue to trade on the TSX Venture Exchange (the "**TSXV**"), while the ADSs would trade on Nasdaq, providing U.S. investors with the ability to invest through the familiar U.S. market infrastructure. evidence.title: RA Capital launches rare disease company Oak Hill Bio onto Nasdaq via SPAC
evidence.body: [e004:f01] The new entity will be called Oak Hill Bio and will launch with $175 million in cash, which includes $75 million from RACC’s trust account and a $100 million private financing from RA, according to a Monday release . [e004:f02] The new funding will accompany Oak Hill’s recent $32.5 million series A financing to propel the development of rugonersen (OHB-724) through a phase 3 readout and NDA submission planned for 2029. [e004:f03] Rugonersen is an antisense oligonucleotide (ASO) for the treatment of Angelman syndrome, which causes severe developmental delays, issues with balance and movement, and speech limitations. [e004:f04] Angelman syndrome occurs in one in 15,000 births, according to the Angelman Syndrome Foundation. [e004:f05] Roche originally developed rugonersen as a therapy to restore neuronal ubiquitin protein ligase E3A (UBE3A) expression, and Oak Hill licensed the asset in early 2025 . [e004:f06] Deletions and mutations in the maternal UBE3A allele cause Angelman syndrome and UBE3A is required for normal brain development and function. [e004:f07] The drug is designed to bind to the UBE3A-ATS transcript and degrade it in the central nervous system to un-silence the UBE3A paternal allele, potentially improving neuronal functioning. [e004:f08] “Oak Hill Bio combines compelling science, a management team with a broad range of experience, and an extremely promising rare disease asset, making for a solid foundation for continued success,” said Matthew Hammond, Ph.D., partner at RA Capital and CEO and director of RACC, in a release. [e004:f09] Rugonersen will be in the running with Ultragenyx’s GTX-102 and Ionis Pharmaceuticals’ breakthrough designated ION582, both of which are in phase 3 studies for patients with Angelman syndrome as well. [e004:f10] Takeda spun out Oak Hill in 2022 with two assets obtained from the Japanese pharma's $62 billion takeover of Shire in 2019. [e004:f11] Oak Hill Bio CEO Josh Distler will serve as CEO of the combined company. [e004:f12] The deal is expected to close by the end of the year, with the new entity trading under the ticker symbol OAKH. [e004:f13] “The resources provided by this amazing group of investors will enable us to continue to aggressively develop rugonersen,” Distler said via release. [e004:f14] “We have dosed the first patient in the phase 3 BEACON trial and look forward to evaluating the potential of rugonersen to meaningfully impact the lives of patients living with Angelman syndrome and their families.” RA Capital Oak Hill Bio special purpose acquisition company genetic diseases Angelman syndrome Deals Biotech。

evidence.title: S&P: BI governor's resignation won't affect Indonesia's credit rating
evidence.body: [e005:f01] JAKARTA - S&P Global Ratings said the resignation of Bank Indonesia (BI) Governor Perry Warjiyo would have no immediate impact on Indonesia's sovereign credit rating. [e005:f02] However, the global ratings agency acknowledged that the transition at the central bank has added uncertainty over the future direction of Indonesia's monetary policy. [e005:f03] As previously reported by , Perry submitted his resignation to President Prabowo Subianto over the weekend. [e005:f04] He has been temporarily replaced by Destry Damayanti. [e005:f05] After meeting Prabowo at the State Palace on Monday (27/7), Destry said BI's policy stance would remain unchanged following Perry's departure. [e005:f06] She also reaffirmed the central bank's commitment to continuing its rupiah intervention operations and macroprudential policies. [e005:f07] Read Also: S&P DJIの再査定の中、ジャカルタ総合株価指数（JCI）は1.89％減 Rain Yin, Sovereign Analyst at S&P Global Ratings, said Indonesia's current sovereign credit rating primarily reflects the country's fiscal position and external balance sheet, both of which are expected to improve over the coming months. [e005:f08] "This comes as the pace of policy changes becomes more stable and implementation risks decline," Yin said, as quoted by Reuters. [e005:f09] While markets are likely to become more volatile following Perry's resignation, Yin said the recovery in Indonesia's underlying economic fundamentals would not, in itself, affect the country's sovereign credit rating. [e005:f10] "However, if we conclude that the deterioration in Indonesia's fiscal or external indicators is more prolonged or structural rather than temporary, this could increase the risk of a downgrade over time," Yin said. [e005:f11] Earlier this month, S&P affirmed Indonesia's sovereign credit rating at 'BBB/A-2' with a stable outloo k, citing improving market sentiment through the middle of the year. [e005:f12] Other major ratings agencies, including Moody's and Fitch Ratings, had already revised Indonesia's outlook to negative earlier this year, reflecting concerns over the fiscal direction of President Prabowo's administration. (KR/ZH) Add as a preferred source on Google Read Also S&Pがインドネシアのクレジット格付けを確認した後、ジャカルタ総合株価指数（JCI）は1.92％増。

evidence.title: EQ Resources Pursues NASDAQ or NYSE Listing to Tap US Investor Demand for Tungsten Supply
S&P グローバル、2026年度第2四半期の決算を発表
NYの視点：【今週の注目イベント】FOMC、日銀や英中銀の金融政策決定会合、米PCE、米国債入札
evidence.body: [e001:f01] 金融政策では連邦公開市場委員会（FOMC）が予定されているほか、日銀や英中銀は金融政策決定会合を予定している。 [e001:f02] 米国では連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）がインフレ指標として特に注視しているPCE価格指数が発表されるほか、4−6月期国内総生産（GDP）が発表予定。 [e001:f03] さらに、米財務省が2年、5年、7年債入札を予定しており、注目材料となる。 [e001:f04] 7月28、29日開催の米連邦公開市場委員会（FOMC）会合では、政策金利を据え置きが予想されている。 [e001:f05] ただ、最近の原油高、インフレ懸念で短期米金融市場は利上げを40％弱織り込んだ。 [e001:f06] 年内2回の利上げの可能性が織り込まれつつある。 [e001:f07] 一方、最新の消費者物価指数（CPI）や生産者物価指数（PPI）は鈍化となり、緊急利上げの必要性はあまり見られない。 [e001:f08] FRBのウォーシュ議長は成長や雇用が安定している一方、インフレが過去5年間目標に達していないと懸念を表明。 [e001:f09] 米イラン緊張の再開で原油が再び上昇基調にあり、市場では利上げ観測が高まりつつある。 [e001:f10] ただ、議長は着任後初めてのFOMCで5つの作業部会立ち上げを発表し、改革の最中。 [e001:f11] FRBのメンバーの見通しに有効性が見られないとし、議長は会見でも明確な見通しを示さないと見られる。 [e001:f12] 作業部会の結果は年内に明らかになるようだが、それまで、政策を修正の可能性は少ないと見る。 [e001:f13] 米PCE価格指数では、燃料価格の下落を背景に総合は鈍化が想定されている。 [e001:f14] また、コアも金融サービス項目の鈍化で、押し下げられる見通しとなっている。 [e001:f15] 記事に関するキーワード 原油価格 流通・小売 PMI 米国 提供元の記事 （外部サイトに移動します）。

evidence.title: 米国のハイテク企業が14万人の雇用を削減した。
evidence.body: [e002:f01] 米国では、多くのテクノロジー企業が事業再編の一環として、今年も人員削減を続けている。 [e002:f02] Đài truyền hình Việt Nam • 27/07/2026 米国のテクノロジー企業が14万人の雇用を削減 - 写真：VNA 人工知能 （AI）は、技術インフラへの前例のない投資の波を牽引しているが、同時に大企業の資源配分方法も変えつつある。 [e002:f03] フィナンシャル・タイムズの分析によると、米国のテクノロジー企業は年初から約14万人の雇用を削減しており、これは米国全体の雇用喪失の3分の1以上を占めている。 [e002:f04] アマゾン、メタ、マイクロソフト、オラクルは、人工知能（AI）とデータセンターへの投資にリソースを振り向けた結果、約5万人の雇用削減に貢献した。 [e002:f05] これらの企業は今年、AIインフラに約7250億ドルを費やすと予想されている。 [e002:f06] オラクル社は、3月に実施した人員削減の結果、2026会計年度末時点で前年度より2万1000人少ない従業員数となった。 [e002:f07] 7月28日に開催されたホーチミン市ビジネス協会（HUBA）の今年上半期の活動報告会では、多くの会員が、経済は回復を続けているものの、市場、投入コスト、サプライチェーンの変動といった圧力に依然として直面していると指摘した。 [e002:f08] これは、アクティビジョン・ブリザードを750億ドルで買収してからわずか3年後の事業再編の一環である。 [e002:f09] Challengerのデータによると、2023年5月以降、最大17万人のオフィス職の喪失がこの技術に関連しているとみられている。 [e002:f10] テクノロジー企業BlockのCEOであるジャック・ドーシー氏は、AIが労働力のニーズを変えているとして、5月に同社の従業員1万人のほぼ半数を解雇した。 [e002:f11] 一方、アマゾンやマイクロソフトなど一部の大手テクノロジー企業は、AIを人員削減の理由として挙げることを避けており、AI技術の導入は従業員解雇の決定の根拠ではないと明確に述べている。 [e002:f12] Báo Thanh niên một giờ trước ザライ量子年2026の開会式および国際量子コンピューティングハッカソンの表彰式 Báo Gia Lai 2 giờ trước カテゴリ別トレンド あるiPhoneモデルの価格が50％以上下落し、過去最安値を記録した。 [e002:f13] Báo Sài Gòn Giải phóng 30 phút trước 本日の米ドル為替レート（7月29日）：市場がFRBの決定を待つ中、米ドルは小幅に下落した。 [e002:f14] Công Luận một giờ trước 本日の燃料価格（7月29日）：世界の原油価格は5％下落。 [e002:f15] VietNamNet một giờ trước Google Trends 今日の星占い、2026年7月29日の12星座の星占いをご覧ください：丑年の金運は徐々に上昇しています。 [e002:f16] Việt Nam 17 giờ trước 人物 ハノイで開催されたミス・ベトナム2026の予選には、数百人の女子学生が詰めかけた。
